name: Yuzu Chaya
description: A playful, modular theme for small Japanese tea and wagashi shops that sell loose-leaf sencha, hojicha and matcha, teaware and seasonal sweets online, laid out like a bento box: rounded tiles in yuzu yellow, pale kinari paper, fresh matcha and charcoal-green ink on a twelve-column grid that folds neatly to one column on a phone, small hand-drawn tea leaves, yuzu and curls of steam that wiggle on hover, temperature stickers and handwritten notes, plus a brewing guide with temperatures and times, a monthly tea box subscription with plans and a signup form, and WooCommerce shop, product, cart, checkout and account templates styled to match.
